notes: He ranks on a five-row school scale, top to bottom: Graduating with honors (he equates it with S), Solo group project, See me after class / midterm talk, You're in the wrong class / don't meet the prereqs, Expelled. Rows are set by dragging cards on screen; captions only carry what he says aloud.

prior is a derived 0-1 number for code to start from, not his: tags and consumables map rows 1..5 to 1.0, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25, 0.0 (the 'updated' tag rows are the current 1.0.1 view). Joker priors are read by hand off his verdict words ('easy smash' ~0.85-0.95, 'smash' ~0.75, 'smash, not proud' ~0.6, 'gentle/conditional' ~0.45-0.5, 'mid' ~0.4, 'pass' ~0.15-0.2, Expelled ~0.05) and his stated comparisons, within rarity (a common's 0.85 is not an uncommon's 0.85); null where he never places the joker aloud. Measure before trusting.

Joker rows are partly about fun: Obelisk is 'very strong' but expelled for not being fun, Vagabond for being work, Chicot held down for making the game boring. Commons are judged against commons. Several placements moved during the stream; 'said' keeps the final words.
'relative' (tags, consumables) holds his stated comparisons and is more reliable than the row.

A tag's row is how good the tag is, not whether to skip for it: he ranks Economy Tag top yet rarely skips for it. Skip decisions are in claims.json (skips_tags.play-every-blind and the per-tag claims).

rows_top_to_bottom.meaning: above and beyond; excels in every situation
does a lot on its own, picks up the slack for other jokers; graduates but not with honors across the board
did all right for a while then fell off; hope for redemption
doesn't meet the prereqs; shouldn't be in this class

jokers.verbal_verdicts: For nearly every joker he gives a 'smash or pass' verdict instead of naming the row: smash = he'd take it, pass/no = he wouldn't. Strength of the smash, high to low: 'easy/easiest/top-of-the-line/big-time smash' and 'off the charts' > 'proud smash' > 'smash' > 'smash but not proud / wouldn't tell anybody' > 'gentle/soft smash' > 'conditional smash' > 'mid' > 'pass'/'no'. Most rows are set by dragging on screen and only some are said aloud; `row` is filled only when he names it (or a chatter names it and he accepts).
caveats: Rankings are partly vibes, art and fun ('this is based on Vibes only'): Obelisk is called 'very strong' but expelled for not being fun, Vagabond for being a lot of work, Chicot held down because it 'makes the game boring', and Brainstorm and Midas Mask are discussed partly on art.
Commons are judged relative to commons ('we're talking about commons here'); a common 'easy smash' is not worth an uncommon 'smash'.

Several placements moved after chat donations or arguments (Credit Card, 8 Ball, Clown, Superposition, Red Card, Golden Joker, Green Joker, Erosion, Lucky Cat, Luchador, Brainstorm, Vagabond); the table gives the final stated position where one exists.
The uncommon video opens with 'we're going to cut all that stuff out', so some uncommons (e.g. Four Fingers) were never placed in the captions.
jokers.rough_power_reading: Not his words: a rough reading of the verbal verdicts for a value table. easy smash/top ~ S-A, smash ~ B, mid/conditional ~ C, pass ~ D, expelled/wrong class ~ F.

tags_and_consumables.note: Both videos use his 5-row school scale, not letters, and place cards on a visual board, so many rows are inferred from spoken comparisons ('placement' field; 'relative' gives his stated comparisons). He equates row 1 with S tier ('You think Purple Seal is S tier? You think Purple Seal going to graduate with honors?').

B.pack_priority_by_hand.Flush: Arcana > Celestial; keep Cartomancer over Space Joker
B.pack_priority_by_hand.Straight: Celestial > Arcana; keep Space Joker over Cartomancer; skip Standard packs
B.pack_priority_by_hand.High Card (held-in-hand): Arcana (Strength to target rank) > Celestial (Pluto +10); Celestial only with money to spare
B.pack_priority_by_hand.Two Pair / Full House: Arcana (Strength) and Standard packs for duplicates of the target rank; Celestial OK
B.pack_priority_by_hand.money < $25: no packs except Celestial when short on scoring

B.valuation_formulas.additive_joker_factor: (axisTotalBefore + X) / axisTotalBefore, chips and Mult axes separate
B.valuation_formulas.copy_target: argmax over jokers of (T + X) / T for additive, x for xMult
B.valuation_formulas.sell_target: argmin over jokers of score(board) / score(board without j)
B.valuation_formulas.buy_under_cap: buy if hands saved per round x $1 >= interest lost per round

E.money_by_ante.rule: Shop 1: buy at least one joker (no interest floor); take $4 packs over $6 Jumbos when money <= ~$10; at White, bank if the next blind is already safe in 2 hands

Hold >= $25; spend surplus above $25 freely; keep ~$8-12 extra for the next shop's packs/voucher (implied)
